about: Files a device writes beside a recording that are not recordings of their own: a smaller proxy copy, a thumbnail picture, a preview. Each row names the side file's path and the paths of the original it was made from. `side` and `originals` are matched at the end of a path, starting at a folder boundary; `{part}` stands for one or more characters inside one folder or file name, and the same part fills the other paths. `drop` says when the side file is not kept: `always`, or `when_original_present` (a proxy with no original beside it may be the only copy, so it stays). `carry` names the results kept about the side file that move onto the original when the side file is dropped, the more complete one staying. A new camera or device is one more row. `set_aside_as` is the Recently Deleted state (src/namespace-set-aside.json) a dropped side file goes to.
